title: Subtraction in modular arithmetic
statement: Let $p$ be a positive natural number, and let $r$ and $x$ be natural numbers. The residue modulo $p$ of the remainder of $r+p-(x\bmod p)$ upon division by $p$ equals the residue of $r$ minus the residue of $x$ in $\mathbb{Z}/p\mathbb{Z}$.
